methodology.data: Exact decoded QVP outlines exported offline; QVB parsing, not original QVP decompression. Network excluded; assets fetched before timing.
methodology.setup: Warm setup: every mode/page is exercised during untimed visual validation, then every mode is set up/disposed again before idle calibration. New renderer per trial, persistent worker; includes buffer copy/transfer, preparation, context/path/mesh creation, first draw and one-pixel synchronous readback.
methodology.cpu: JavaScript draw submission duration, not GPU execution time.
methodology.intervals: requestAnimationFrame callback intervals, not hardware presentation timestamps. Late means >1.5 times measured idle median.
methodology.preview_zoom: Canvas cached scales a 1x raster and is temporarily softer; direct Canvas and WebGL rerender geometry.
methodology.sharp_zoom: All rerender at each zoom. Cached Canvas refreshes a viewport-sized raster each frame.
methodology.highlight: Moving word bounding-box band behind black ink; no ink recolouring or layout engine.
methodology.memory: Explicitly sized source-cache, live geometry-copy and mesh buffers plus nominal RGBA surfaces only. Canvas Path2D native storage, driver/MSAA/swapchain allocations, JS overhead, transients and total process memory are not measured.
methodology.order: Page, renderer and scenario order rotate across repeats. Explicit trial order is recorded. Two idle frames follow each context disposal.
methodology.warmup: One complete 90-frame trajectory before each measured 90-frame trajectory by default.
methodology.quantiles: Sorted sample at floor((n-1)*q); pooled frame quantiles are descriptive, not independent observations or confidence estimates.
methodology.gpu: Adaptive curve flattening (0.2 backing-pixel tolerance through 4x), libtess winding-rule tessellation in worker, single triangle batch for ink, native WebGL MSAA. No WASM.
